globalStyle.realism: Photorealistic live-action footage of a real human presenter recorded in one studio session against a plain ivory backdrop, NOT a furnished room. TRUE-TO-LIFE BODY: natural adult proportions that match his face - broad shoulders, a solid average build that fills the jacket (not slim, not lanky), and SLENDER, NATURAL-SIZE HANDS: each hand no longer than his face, relaxed fingers held close together, never spread wide, hands never closer to the camera than his chest
